- Elevate your jewelry collection with the "Solitaire Spark" Ring, where timeless design meets modern elegance. Crafted from anti-tarnish stainless steel and finished in luxurious gold plating, this ring features a brilliant round centerpiece stone flanked by dazzling cubic zirconia accents on the band. Its sturdy, non-adjustable fit and sophisticated look make it perfect for daily wear, parties, or gifting someone special.
-

- Color: Gold
- Sizes Available:

- Size 8 → Diameter: 1.8cm
- Best Use: Ideal for daily wear, party wear, engagement look, or gifting
- Packaging: Premium black velvet box
